reasons.IDEA000084: The proposed CH enrichment after both anchor sides is also predicted by a shared CH-heavy formula or register. Persistent meaning need not produce literal copying of the written anchor side. The enrichment baseline, weighting, balancing rule and held partition are unspecified. GDT873 uses a different density endpoint and a selected half of eligible anchors; it does not test or falsify this proposal.
reasons.IDEA000085: Stable allocation among nine response pairs could reflect formula-specific collocation or unequal exposure without functional gating. The design specifies no allowed set, distribution, effect criterion, exposure model or held partition. GDT873 collapses pair identity into CH/SH density, so it cannot test this allocation claim.
reasons.IDEA000086: GDT808 already compared the two axes and reported that paragraph, topic and form regime predict expanded/base choice. GDT865 retained the two primary nuisance thresholds after whole-leaf exclusion, without repeating all old controls or establishing meaning. The new proposal does not identify an independently coded channel, its exact predicted change, or an observation separating functional channel use from register or formula composition. A universal semantic operator need not give the same raw frequency direction in different lexical contexts. This is an incomplete proposed method, not a failed semantic experiment or an adjudicated duplicate.

evidence.quote:
Die beiden Achsen sind nicht austauschbar. Training auf L und Vorhersage von DY
ergibt für den kombinierten Score AUC 0,398734; in Gegenrichtung sind es
0,450339. Die lokalen Cross-Axis-Scores liegen nur bei 0,540197 und 0,515150.
Ohne nachträgliches Vorzeichenwenden folgt deshalb
`TWO_DISTINCT_OR_AXIS_BOUND_RELATIONS`. GDT808 lizenziert damit kein
gemeinsames `e`-, Form- oder Operationsmorphem.

Die rohe Registerrichtung macht diese Inkompatibilität sichtbar. Auf DY liegt
`Xeody` in Currier/Register A bei 48 von 51 Ereignissen, in B aber nur bei 100
von 812. Auf L liegt `Xeol` dagegen in A bei 123 von 544, in B bei 150 von 370.
Dass derselbe expanded/base-Kontrast zwischen den Achsen seine
Registerorientierung wechselt, erklärt den negativen Cross-Transfer besser als
eine einzige gemeinsame Bedeutung.

**COMPLETE_PRIMARY_WHOLE_LEAF_ROBUSTNESS_AUDIT.** Both unchanged CORE13 primary
models retain their predeclared nuisance-score thresholds after excluding all
training material from the held physical leaf as well as the held carrier.
This strengthens the specific structural transfer finding beyond the previously
used page-face holdout. It does not establish a translation or reproduce the
full original GDT808 verdict, which required further controls outside this test.

| Primary variation | Old nuisance macro AUC | Whole-leaf nuisance macro AUC | Paired change | Carriers above 0.50 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| L: ol / eol | 0.611534 | 0.616364 | +0.004830 | 10/13 |
| DY: edy / eody | 0.753049 | 0.750323 | -0.002726 | 11/13 |

AUC is ranking discrimination, not percentage transcription or translation
accuracy. The fixed threshold was nuisance carrier-macro AUC at least0.60 and
at least9/13carrier AUCs strictly above0.50. Here nuisance is the original sum
of topic, line-template and form/regime scores; it is not a semantic predictor.

limits: 873 is not a test of either original84/85 endpoint. Capacity remains unmeasured for those designs. No semantic falsification, automatic duplicate merge, source admission or old-route reopening.
